recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, low-angle portrait of a woman with long blonde-streaked hair, framed by a white fur garment against a dark wood-paneled background. The composition features a mix of organic textures and sharp, stylized typography positioned in the lower-left quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between soft white fur and hard dark wood grain
Dynamic interplay between vertical hair strands and horizontal arm placement
Typographic weight anchoring the lower-left negative space
Warm skin tones harmonizing with the brown background
coreInvariants: Low-angle perspective looking up at the subject
Subject's face partially obscured by hair strands
High-contrast white text against dark background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, scaled to a tight head-and-shoulders crop.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and mouth serve as the primary focal point, with the white fur providing a secondary textural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the subject's face down the vertical lines of the hair to the typography in the lower left, then follows the arm upward.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Concentrated in the upper left and lower left, utilized for typographic placement.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep browns and wood tones provide the foundation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white from the fur and typography creates high-value contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Soft pinks in the makeup and clothing add a feminine touch.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted saturation with high value contrast between the subject's highlights and the background shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses a distressed, brush-like script with sharp terminals
Secondary text uses a clean, ultra-condensed geometric sans-serif
Script letters feature varying stroke widths and a hand-drawn quality
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended descenders on script characters to create a baseline flourish
Interlocking or overlapping script characters for a fluid look
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between organic, expressive script and rigid, industrial sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule or baseline flourish extending from script

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the expressive, hand-drawn energy of the primary text.
Matches the ultra-condensed, clean look of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-fashion portrait of a woman with long blonde-streaked hair, wearing a white fur coat, posed against a dark vertical wood-grain wall. Use a low-angle perspective and warm, soft lighting. Ensure the left side of the frame has sufficient dark negative space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, white, distressed brush-script name in the lower-left corner. Directly beneath it, add a smaller, white, ultra-condensed uppercase sans-serif title.

verificationChecks: Is the text legible against the wood grain?
Does the fur texture appear soft and high-detail?

adjustableVariables: Degree of hair obscuring the face
Distress level of the script font
mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness

mustAchieve: Tactile texture in fur and wood

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the hair strands look natural and integrated.
Check that the white text doesn't blow out the highlights.
Verify the low-angle distortion feels intentional, not accidental.
Confirm the wood grain direction is vertical.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait subject + Textural contrast (Fur vs Wood) + Lower-left typographic anchor = Urban Glamour Aesthetic
